name: comp-505
blurb: Calendar and time slot selector side-by-side in a responsive layout.
description: A date picker paired with a scrollable time slot list. Selecting a date updates the time slots shown. Disabled slots are unclickable.
use_when: Users need to book an appointment by picking both date and time.
avoid_when: Small touch screens — the two-column layout becomes cramped on mobile.
a11y: Uses aria-live to announce selections. Calendar handles focus and keyboard navigation. Button states communicate availability.
